versions.title: Harvest Moon

skins.name: Zombie Farmer Pumpkin
skins.story: He fell asleep in the pumpkin patch on harvest night and woke up carved, glowing and grinning, and honestly he likes it better this way.

skins.name: Zombie Farmer Scarecrow
skins.story: The crows took pity on the old scarecrow, so now he stands in the cornfield with button eyes and a stitched smile and lets them eat whatever they like.

skins.name: Zombie Farmer Beekeeper
skins.story: He lifted his veil for just one second to smell the honey, and the bees have been reminding him of it ever since.

versions.note: When the harvest moon rises over the fields, three new farmers join the gang: one who grew a little too close to his pumpkins, one who guards the crows instead of scaring them, and one who keeps bees and regrets it.

versions.title: The Barnyard Gang

skins.name: Zombie Farmer Cow
skins.story: The herd only listens to one of their own, so he zipped himself into a spotted cow suit, horns and all, and has been chewing the same piece of wheat for a week.

skins.name: Zombie Farmer Chicken
skins.story: A brown hen chose his straw hair as the warmest nest on the farm, and he is far too scared of her beak to ever take it off.

skins.name: Zombie Farmer Pig
skins.story: He spent one hot summer rolling in the mud with the pigs, and when the mud finally dried he came out pink, snouted and with a curly little tail.

versions.note: The animals on the farm got tired of being chased, so the gang made friends with them instead: one farmer moved into a cow costume, one lets a chicken nest on his head, and one simply became a pig.

versions.title: Wild Weather

skins.name: Zombie Farmer Storm
skins.story: A small grey rain cloud followed him home from the fields one afternoon, and now it waters his crops, soaks his coat and strikes his hat whenever he complains.

skins.name: Zombie Farmer Sunflower
skins.story: He stood in the sunflower field for so many summers, always turned towards the sun, that the petals finally grew all the way around his face.

skins.name: Zombie Farmer Swamp
skins.story: He went to check the flooded rice field and simply never came back out, so now a lily pad shades his head, a frog keeps him company and his eyes glow like fireflies.

versions.note: Rain, sun and fog all arrived at the farm in the same week, and three farmers came back changed: one with his own personal storm cloud, one who turned towards the sun, and one who never left the flooded field.
